name: smart-crime-mapping-monorepo
description: Fullstack Smart Crime Mapping and Predictive Insights Platform

scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
